title: Geometry and Stochastic Analysis of Flow and Diffusion Models: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2611.12107v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow-based and diffusion-based models have become the principal means of learning and sampling high-dimensional probability distributions, from images and video to proteins, molecules and physical fields, and increasingly language. Each carries a simple law to the law of the data along a curve of probability measures, and behind the variety of their names lie three geometries, those of the state space on which the data live, of the space of probability measures through which the curve passes, and of the space of paths traced by the generating process. A single analytic idea runs through the subject. Every score identity used to train a diffusion model is an integration by parts, on the noise, on the data or on Wiener space, and Malliavin calculus extends this to nonlinear and infinite-dimensional diffusions. translated_title: 流与扩散模型的几何与随机分析：综述
translated_abstract: 基于流的模型和基于扩散的模型已成为学习与采样高维概率分布的主要手段，其应用涵盖图像、视频、蛋白质、分子和物理场，并日益扩展到语言领域。每种模型都沿着一条概率测度曲线将一个简单的规律传递到数据的规律之中，而在其多样的名称背后隐藏着三种几何：数据所栖居的状态空间的几何、曲线所穿越的概率测度空间的几何，以及生成过程所描绘的路径空间的几何。一个统一的解析思想贯穿整个领域：用于训练扩散模型的每一个得分恒等式本质上都是一次分部积分——在噪声上、在数据上或在维纳空间上进行——而Malliavin演算将这一思想推广到非线性与无穷维扩散过程。本文以完整的定义系统发展了这些理论基础，并将其贯穿应用于归一化流、流匹配和少步映射等方法之中。
tldr: 这篇综述从三种几何（状态空间、概率测度空间、路径空间）与随机分析的统一视角阐明流与扩散模型的数学基础，指出所有得分恒等式本质上都是分部积分，并将Malliavin演算等工具贯穿于归一化流、流匹配与少步映射等方法之中。
en_tdlr: This survey unifies flow and diffusion models through the lens of three geometries (state space, probability measure space, and path space) and stochastic analysis, showing that every score identity is fundamentally an integration by parts, and develops Malliavin calculus foundations across normalizing flows, flow matching, and few-step maps.
